name: Noah Berc
bio: Noah Berc is an award-winning Canadian filmmaker and actor. He is an ACTRA performer with a growing list of on-screen credits. Behind the camera, Noah writes, directs and produces horror short films that have screened at international festivals like Vancouver Horror Show, Chicago Horror Film Festival, Nightmares, Great Canadian Horror Show, ReelOut, FogFest, and Fright Nights.
